details:
A lot of worlds have been uploaded recently, often with AI thumbnails, that are uploads of purchased world prefabs with no modifications aside from all connections to the original creator being removed and often extra patreon etc. perks inside. 

These often get popular and, as such, make money, which usually breaks the original world creator's ToS and is contributing to the depressing quality and repetitiveness of worlds on Popular.

This game has a pretty severe problems with this. If an avatar is sold on the marketplace but someone buys the files and uploads it as public, against the creator's ToS, it is removed. Why should the same not happen for worlds, especially when the original worlds make money using CE too?

If not, possibly a required checkbox in the sdk that a world is a reupload with a field for link to the original world that'll be displayed on the world page in the menu, and a report field if it isn't filled? 

Creators deserve credit, this should not be as normal as it is.
title: Remove monetized/creator's-ToS-breaking re-uploads of sold worlds or add a required checkbox that a world is a reupload.
